biotools.summary: MMMx is a toolbox for protein ensemble modeling and analysis, supporting the design of experiments to characterize the distributed structure of proteins with disordered domains. It leverages AlphaFold2 predictions and offers various analysis and visualization tools for conformational ensembles.
